steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This room...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Take a look, Dagda, this is our old home!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Oooh!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Must've been pretty good, living here!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: No shit it was!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Hannah never did the cleaning, though.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Oi, Vina! How many more times do you want me to fess up to my mistakes?!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I dropped in now and then after you left, tidied things a little. Been a few years, but shouldn't be much different than it was?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: My whole stash is still here! Always knew you were tight, Baird!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: *sigh* Fancy me having to be the poor girl left behind.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Don't give me that, Baird. You told us you were going to stay!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: How you need to be in your own bed, be shambling the moment you were out of Norport!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Yeah, well, maybe I should've tried and put up with it.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Stuff that! You think I don't know you? We're all stuck in hell when you can't sleep!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: If I'm tired enough to go six feet under, the last thing I want is you trying to chinwag with me again!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Hahah, well, I've been falling asleep just about anywhere these days.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What, too tired?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Might be.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Just, found out sleeping's the... best way to empty your head.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...Once my Rhodes Island mission's done, Baird, I'll bring you lot out of here.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: All of you.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Here, here, here, let's pop some bottles to celebrate getting back together after all these years!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: It's cheap stuff, but hey, maybe leaving it so long made it better?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Morgan, give Baird a read of those books you wrote! Tell her about our adventures!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hey, Baird, you're missing your chance to become part of the King's chronicles—

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: ...Morgan? What's wrong? You've been pale as a sheet this whole time.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: We finally made it home! You ought to chin up a little.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I'm thinking about... the... hand I stepped on.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: It was probably just some accident.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: It had a thumb ring on it. Something's telling me I've seen it somewhere before.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I feel like I should remember...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: But I just keep drawing a blank.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I... Baird, what's been happening in Norport all these days?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Not much, Morgan. Maybe it was just an accident.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Everyone's been trying their hardest to survive, that's all.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: It's in the past, anyway. You're back now. We'll be out of here soon. That's enough for us.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Norport's our home.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I used to picture what it'd be like when we came back. I thought we'd spend our first night piling into that snooker place to play until the sun came up, then go drinking next door until it all went dark.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Or maybe we'd go to McClaren at the video place and reserve all the seats, end up watching ten whole adventure movies back to back.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I saw it. But I didn't dare look properly.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: All that broken glass caked with the blood, and the... shadows all on the ground inside.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: You should get a proper kip. Like me.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Must be shattered after coming all this way.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina, you've got that Realmblade now. You'll be the hero, yeah?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You'll save Norport. We'll save Norport.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: This'll all just pass, right?!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We'll take back our old lives.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Maybe if...

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Nah. Look how late it is. Get some rest, muckers.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: We've got mountains to deal with tomorrow.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Baird's right, Morgan. We all need to... get some proper rest.
Siege huddles up on the sofa. She used to spend countless nights here. Every inch of it feels as familiar as ever.
She still remembers how they picked up this couch at the flea market all those years ago, the four of them breaking their backs to carry the bloody piece of tat all the way to the gym's upstairs.
She reckoned it pretty wide back then, but soon enough she was resting her feet on the armrest just to fit.
In the dark, Siege's hand brushes over the sofa, feeling each nook and cranny.
Here's the gash left from when Hannah was practicing with her knife. Three whole days she felt guilty about that.

Morgan spilled a whole bottle of drink here. She bought a tin of awful cleaning stuff to treat the stain and it got worse the more she tried. The whole patch is still smooth as a baby's bottom to this day.
Baird put the iron down here and forgot about it. Nearly burned the whole room down.
She used to believe these days would never change.
She used to be sure these days would never change.
This is their Glasgow Gang. Their neighborhood. Their stomping grounds. Their home.
It's true, she's back.
But deep inside, she's not one bit happy.
That 'memoir' of Morgan's crosses her mind again. The Legendary Vina and Her Legendary Mates.
Siege gently touches the Sighs of Kings, resting by her side.
As ice-cold as it ever was.
Leader. Hero. King.
King of the Siege, Vina.
Alexandrina Vina Victoria.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Something on your mind, Vina?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: These clothes are too heavy. I can't catch my breath sleeping in them.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm looking for stuff that fits me better.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: In that drawer.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: *huff*—

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Haven't gotten any taller, mm?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Come on, we're adults. We stopped growing ages ago.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: You never know with these things. I remember when we first met, you were only about this tall...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Enough, enough. It's the same old guff you always spout about time passing.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I haven't had anyone in years to tell that same old guff to.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm sorry, Baird.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I'm just glad you're back, Your Majesty Vina.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Don't call me that.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: King of the Siege, same as ever, then.

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: What is it, Lady Ermengarde?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Don't call me Lady. I'm not that old yet.

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: I'm sorry... um, Miss Ermengarde? I'm not quite sure how old you liches are...

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: *sigh* Forget it. Lady Ermengarde will do.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: This high-speed battleship really has been reduced to tatters. Grr. And the Vampire's cohort gave this place a bathing too.

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: General Manfred says this is going to be the start of the Sarkaz's victory.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Hrmph. The Sarkaz's victory.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: *sigh* And old Dame Kal'tsit kept warning me a future like this wouldn't bring anything about for us.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Still, I just can't figure it out. Why would my tutor have had a Feline friend for so long?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: We're leaving. I hate the stench of this place.

steps.name: Sarkaz Soldier
steps.text: Come with me, please. Her Highness Theresa is waiting for you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, good morning.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We need to make some plans... for our upcoming operation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Sarkaz are treating the citizens as insurance that they won't be directly artillery-struck, but whether the Military Commission or the dukes, we can't truly count on their benevolence in this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And even if we ignore the game that's ongoing between them, we're still bearing witness to the terrible state the blockade zone is in.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: You've seen the state of chaos Norport is in these days. Far easier said than done to change the status quo.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: That medicine and stuff you brought with... I gave it a count. Afraid it's only a drop in the bucket.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right, what you can accomplish is going to be very limited with our help alone. But that's no reason for us to hold back.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Investigation of the airship and evacuation plans for the plate's citizens are simultaneous work for us. We can't afford to overlook anything.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's the matter, Miss Delphine?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: You lot have the chops, right? You wriggled through the Sarkaz blockade to get here, so I'm guessing it's as easy for you to slip back out.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can say with pride that those gathered here now are all extraordinary operators of Rhodes Island, but I'm very sorry, Miss Delphine... I think we may not live up to what you're imagining.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: When pitted against those steering the war from behind the scenes, we may very well be called puny.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: So... you only got here thanks to some help?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Unfortunately, it's a 'deal' as the man loved to put it, and not a fantastic one at that.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Are you... a Sarkaz?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Didn't think a duke would've found another Sarkaz lot to work with instead...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hmph. Someone thinks too much.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: No, I just read the papers usually.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Very good habit.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: You're still planning the evac right now, aren't you? Did your fancy-pants backer agree to help?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Sadly for you, no. All signs say she doesn't care.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: But you lot obviously do.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hah. Welcome to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I'm keeping my opinions to myself, though. My concern is whether we can get out of here alive.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Then I've a proposal. Rhodes Islanders, this may be a bit of a risk...

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: The Sarkaz have locked down every information channel out of Norport, and I think I can guess what their excuse to the wider public is.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: And see, I trust any of the dukes to know it is nothing more than an excuse.

spans.text: And see, I trust any of the dukes to know it

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But they won't spoil the facade themselves. In fact, the dukes and the Military Commission of Kazdel have a quiet understanding on that.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Yes, the Sarkaz are using this plate's people as an excuse. Aren't the dukes? My guess is if the Sarkaz did slaughter every last soul here, a few dukes would be breathing a sigh of relief.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: In a war, some only see ethics as a burden.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Yeah, you're not wrong.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: So we... go and break that silent understanding.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: We need to give some of the dukes a push. Make them act more decisively.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Before we're all dead here for real.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Days it's been, Golding, and still not a word from you.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: You're not this reticent a person, as far as we know.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: How are the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: They've left the city.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: How many of them are left?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Not many, I wager.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Fine, back to your silence. Does it bring you any peace?

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: I'm simply... remembering them. Remembering them all.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Enough, enough, Golding. You don't belong to them by nature, and you're free in any case to forget that insubstantial sense of affiliation.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: It wasn't your hands that killed them. Most simply do just die in war. You even came up with a word for it—'sacrifice.'

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: And most of those names, the people hiding behind them, you've never so much as met.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Does becoming a member of a collective instill joy or pride in you?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Regretfully, as you've seen, we can only belong to ourselves in the end.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: No. I used to believe that...

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: At first, I believed I fought for our shared dream, for the Self-Salvation Corps' cause.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: In these past days, I've realized that might not have been the case.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Lettou was right. We are all the same kind.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: I told him he was pessimistic... yet look at me. Whether I admit it or not... I'm someone who despairs easily myself.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: The Corps' members may fight with pure ideals in heart, but the Corps itself does not.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Take Clovisia, or Allerdale... both women I respect for their character, yet their aims extend far beyond what they claim out loud.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: For a very long time, I pretended to be blind to that.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: It disillusions you now. You finally realize your undertakings were marred since the start.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: You feel your efforts were all in vain.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Hardly.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: You see, I don't have any cause on my mind. I'm just thinking of the people. Faces upon faces.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Heidi, Feist, Rockrock, old Bill, Adams, little George...

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: I have no standing, and no right to say I should repent for the Self-Salvation Corps. I don't belong to any illusory collectives of that sort.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: But I need... to come face-to-face with every one of them, inside myself.
